::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The first semiconductor fab proposal in Maharashtra — but surrounded by significant feasibility questions.
:::

## What does this facility make?

Plans to house OSAT production lines and advanced wafer-level packaging. No manufacturing has started as of late 2025.

## Why does it matter?

RRP Electronics has received 100 acres from the Maharashtra government and announced a phased investment of over Rs.36,000 crore. However, the project faces serious credibility scrutiny — the company disclosed in November 2025 that it had 'yet to start any sort of semiconductor manufacturing activities' and its annual report showed only two full-time employees. This project is tracked here for completeness but should be viewed with caution.
